questions.label: Purpose
questions.ask: What may each side use the other's confidential information for?
options: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship
Evaluating a purchase or pilot of our product

questions.label: NDA term
questions.ask: How long can the parties keep sharing information under the NDA?

questions.label: Protection period
questions.ask: How long must shared information stay confidential?
questions.fills: Cover: Term of Confidentiality (trade secrets stay protected while they remain trade secrets)

questions.label: Protection start
questions.ask: When does that protection period start?
options: From the date of the last disclosure
questions.fills: Cover: Term of Confidentiality start (skip when protection is forever)

questions.label: How the NDA is agreed
questions.ask: How will the other side agree to the NDA?
options: Clickthrough: they accept online and it starts then
Signed with each party; their details filled in at signing
questions.fills: Cover: Effective Date, Party 2 and signature block. Clickthrough: Party 2 is the company or person who accepts this MNDA and the Effective Date is the date Party 2 first accepts. Party 1 is company-legal-name with legal-contact-email or company-address as notice address.
questions.follow_up: If signed, ask who signs for the company (name and title).

questions.label: Changes to the standard terms
questions.ask: Do you need any change to the standard NDA terms?
questions.fills: Cover: Changes to Standard Terms ('None' when no changes)
